title: Greetings and Letters
text:
A short greeting can say a great deal about a relationship. Dear Sir or Madam signals distance and formality, whereas Hi there suggests familiarity and ease. Writers who choose carelessly may accidentally offend a reader who expected more respect, or confuse one who was hoping for warmth. The first line sets expectations for everything that follows.

The same principle applies to closing lines. Yours faithfully conveys deference, while Cheers implies a relaxed exchange between equals. Language teachers often ask students to compare pairs like these so they can notice patterns instead of memorising phrases. Over time, learners develop an intuition for which options suit which situations.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what does 'Dear Sir or Madam' signal?
According to paragraph two, what does 'Cheers' imply?
What can be inferred about writers who choose greetings carelessly?
options: They may offend or confuse their readers
They never need to consider tone

questions.text: What does the writer suggest learners develop over time?
options: An intuition for which expressions suit which situations

vocabulary.definition: polite respect shown to someone's authority or status
a close and comfortable relationship with someone
a feeling of knowing something without conscious reasoning

paragraph_translations: አጭር ሰላምታ ስለ አንድ ግንኙነት ብዙ ሊናገር ይችላል። Dear Sir or Madam ርቀትና መደበኛነትን ያሳያል፤ Hi there ግን ቅርበትና ቀላልነትን ይጠቁማል። በግድየለሽነት የሚመርጡ ጸሐፊዎች የበለጠ አክብሮት የሚጠብቅን አንባቢ ሳያስቡት ሊያስከፉ ወይም ሞቅታ ሲጠብቅ የነበረውን ሊያደናግሩ ይችላሉ። የመጀመሪያው መስመር ከዚያ በኋላ ላለው ሁሉ የሚጠበቀውን ይወስናል።

ተመሳሳይ መርህ በመዝጊያ መስመሮችም ይሠራል። Yours faithfully አክብሮትን ያስተላልፋል፤ Cheers ግን በእኩልነት መካከል ያለ ዘና ያለ ውይይትን ያመለክታል። የቋንቋ መምህራን ተማሪዎች ሐረጎችን ከመሸምደድ ይልቅ ንድፎችን እንዲያዩ እንዲህ ያሉ ጥንዶችን እንዲያወዳድሩ ብዙ ጊዜ ይጠይቃሉ። በጊዜ ሂደት ተማሪዎች የትኛው አገላለጽ ለየትኛው ሁኔታ እንደሚስማማ የሚያውቁበትን ውስጣዊ ስሜት ያዳብራሉ።
